title: Puka Nacua opens up about ‘sharp pains’ from injury; Aaron Donald concern grows

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Puka Nacua opens up about ‘sharp pains’ from injury; Aaron Donald concern grows
sources.description: Rams WR Puka Nacua revealed new details about the groin injury that sidelined him for two games, while Aaron Donald missed a second straight practice with back soreness.
